Title: 2023-09-23 Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: === General ===
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  Interface:
  • [Undocumented] Fixed a typo in the Battlegrounds list for Storm League.

=== Heroes: Alexstrasza ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Alextrasza's Dragon Scales to be temporarily disabled after activation when Rooted, Stunned, or Silenced.

=== Heroes: Brightwing ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Brightwing to be able to cast Phase Shift on allied Hero in Stasis.

=== Heroes: Johanna ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue that prevented Johanna from healing Invulnerable allied Heroes with Heaven's Fury.

=== Heroes: Tychus ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Tychus's Armor Piercing Rounds to display in the Status Bar of enemy Heroes hit.
